Title: Verify that a signed-in customer can view their linked applications and signed-in sessions on /account
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- A customer test account has a valid, active session.
- The customer has consented to at least one third-party application.
- The customer is signed in on at least one other device or browser in addition to the current one.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Web; Smoke

Step Action: Navigate to `/account`.
Step Expected: The page loads and displays three panels: profile summary, linked applications, and signed-in sessions.

Step Action: Observe the profile summary panel.
Step Expected: The signed-in customer's profile details are shown.

Step Action: Observe the linked applications panel.
Step Expected: Each application the customer has consented to is listed as a row with a revoke action.

Step Action: Observe the signed-in sessions panel.
Step Expected: Every device/browser holding a live session for the customer is listed.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: No data belonging to another customer is visible on the page.

Title: Verify that an unauthenticated visitor cannot access /account
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The browser holds no valid GK One session (signed out, or a fresh/private browser context).
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Web; Security; Regression

Step Action: Navigate directly to `/account` without signing in.
Step Expected: The visitor is not shown another customer's data; the request is redirected to sign-in or otherwise rejected.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: No profile, application, or session data was rendered to the unauthenticated visitor.

Title: Verify that an expired or invalidated session accessing /account is treated as unauthenticated
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- A customer had a valid session that has since expired or been invalidated (e.g. via "sign out everywhere else" from another browser).
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Web; Session; Regression

Step Action: With the expired/invalidated session's browser, navigate to `/account`.
Step Expected: The customer is treated as signed out and is not shown account data; the request is redirected to sign-in.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The stale session was not honoured to render account data.

Title: Verify that the linked applications list shows every application the customer has consented to and nothing else
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has an established consent grant for two or more distinct applications.
- At least one other application exists in the system that this customer has never consented to.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Consent; Web; Regression

Step Action: Navigate to `/account` and open the linked applications panel.
Step Expected: Every application the customer has an active consent grant for is listed.

Step Action: Compare the listed applications against the applications the customer has not consented to.
Step Expected: No application the customer has not consented to appears in the list.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The linked applications list exactly matches the customer's active consent grants.

Title: Verify that revoking an application asks for confirmation before acting
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has an active consent grant for at least one application, visible in the linked applications panel.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Web; Smoke

Step Action: Select the revoke action on an application row.
Step Expected: A confirmation prompt is shown before any access is revoked.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: No revoke action has taken effect yet; the application remains listed until the confirmation is actioned.

Title: Verify that cancelling the revoke confirmation leaves the application's access unchanged
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has an active consent grant for at least one application.
- The revoke confirmation prompt is open for that application.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Web; Regression

Step Action: Dismiss or cancel the confirmation prompt instead of confirming.
Step Expected: The prompt closes and no revoke action is taken.

Step Action: Refresh the linked applications panel.
Step Expected: The application row is still present.

Step Action: Use the application's existing access token to call an authenticated endpoint.
Step Expected: The token is still accepted.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The application's consent grant and existing tokens remain valid.

Title: Verify that confirming the revoke action removes the application row without a page reload
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has an active consent grant for at least one application, visible in the linked applications panel.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Web; Smoke

Step Action: Select the revoke action on an application row and confirm.
Step Expected: The confirmation is accepted.

Step Action: Observe the linked applications panel immediately after confirming, without refreshing the page.
Step Expected: The row for the revoked application disappears from the panel without a full page reload.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The revoked application no longer appears in the linked applications panel.

Title: Verify that a revoked application's existing access token stops working
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- An application has an active consent grant and the customer holds a currently valid access token issued under that grant.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; OAuth; Security; Regression

Step Action: Revoke the application from the linked applications panel and confirm.
Step Expected: The application's access is revoked.

Step Action: Use the previously issued access token to call an authenticated endpoint (e.g. `userinfo`).
Step Expected: The request is rejected; the token is no longer accepted.

Step Action: Introspect the access token.
Step Expected: The token is reported as inactive.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The revoked application's access token no longer grants access to protected resources.

Title: Verify that a revoked application's existing refresh token stops working when the application had offline_access
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The application's consent policy allows `offline_access`.
- The customer's authorization for the application requested `offline_access`, and a refresh token was issued.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; OAuth; Security; Regression

Step Action: Revoke the application from the linked applications panel and confirm.
Step Expected: The application's access is revoked.

Step Action: Attempt to exchange the previously issued refresh token for a new access token.
Step Expected: The request is rejected; the refresh token no longer works.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The revoked application cannot obtain new access tokens via its previously issued refresh token.

Title: Verify that revoking an application with no refresh token issued only invalidates the access token
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The application's consent policy does not allow `offline_access`, or the authorization did not request it.
- No refresh token was issued for this grant; only an access token exists.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; OAuth; Regression

Step Action: Revoke the application from the linked applications panel and confirm.
Step Expected: The application's access is revoked.

Step Action: Use the previously issued access token to call an authenticated endpoint.
Step Expected: The request is rejected.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The revoked application's access token no longer works, and no refresh token exists to test separately.

Title: Verify that signing in again to a revoked application shows the consent screen
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer previously consented to an application and has since revoked it via the linked applications panel.
- The application's consent policy is set to **Ask each customer for consent**.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Consent; OAuth; Web; Regression

Step Action: Start a new authorization request for the revoked application.
Step Expected: The authorization request is accepted.

Step Action: Sign in with the same customer test account.
Step Expected: The customer is authenticated.

Step Action: Observe the sign-in journey after authentication.
Step Expected: The consent screen is shown again, naming the application and its requested scopes.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The application does not appear as already-consented until the customer allows it again.

Title: Verify the outcome of revoking an application whose consent policy is Admin consent
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- An application's consent policy is set to **Admin consent**.
- The customer has an existing access/session under this application (established without a consent screen, per Admin consent behaviour).
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Consent; OAuth; Web

Step Action: Confirm the application appears in the customer's linked applications panel.
Step Expected: The application is listed even though no per-customer consent screen was ever shown.

Step Action: Revoke the application and confirm.
Step Expected: [UNCERTAIN] The revoke action's effect on an Admin-consent application is not documented — confirm whether revoke is available at all for Admin-consent applications, and if so, what it does given the organisation (not the customer) owns the consent decision.

Step Action: Start a new authorization request for the same application.
Step Expected: [UNCERTAIN] Confirm whether the customer is signed straight back in without a screen (consistent with Admin consent policy) or is shown a consent screen (consistent with per-application revoke behaviour in Test Case 11). This is a direct conflict between the M2 rule ("Admin consent never shows the screen") and the M3 rule ("revoke shows the consent screen again") that needs a product answer before this case can be asserted either way.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: [VERIFY: expected behaviour for revoke on an Admin-consent application / ask GK ID product owner or dev]

Title: Verify that revoking a customer's only remaining linked application succeeds and leaves the list empty
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has exactly one active consent grant, for a single application.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Web; Edge Case

Step Action: Revoke the sole application from the linked applications panel and confirm.
Step Expected: The application's access is revoked.

Step Action: Observe the linked applications panel.
Step Expected: The panel shows an empty state with no application rows.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The linked applications list is empty and the page does not error in this state.

Title: Verify that the signed-in sessions panel lists the current session and marks it as current
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer is signed in on the current browser.
- The customer is also signed in on at least one other device or browser.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Session; Web; Smoke

Step Action: Navigate to `/account` and open the signed-in sessions panel.
Step Expected: Every live session is listed, including the one being used to view the page.

Step Action: Identify the entry corresponding to the current browser.
Step Expected: That entry is visibly marked as the current session, distinct from the others.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: Exactly one session in the panel is marked as current, and it corresponds to the browser in use.

Title: Verify that ending a single other session invalidates only that session
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has a live session on the current browser and at least one other live session on a different device/browser.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Session; Web; Regression

Step Action: In the sessions panel, end the session that is not the current one.
Step Expected: The targeted session is removed from the panel.

Step Action: On the device/browser whose session was ended, attempt to use the application.
Step Expected: The session is no longer valid; the customer is required to sign in again on that device.

Step Action: On the current browser, attempt to use the application.
Step Expected: The current session remains valid and the customer stays signed in.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: Only the targeted session was invalidated; the current session and any other untouched sessions remain live.

Title: Verify that no action in the sessions panel signs the customer out of the browser they are using
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer is viewing `/account` on the current browser with a live session.
- At least one other live session exists on a different device/browser.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Session; Web; Regression

Step Action: Attempt to locate an option to end the current session's entry in the sessions panel.
Step Expected: No available action ends the current session from within the panel (the current session's row does not offer an end/revoke action, or attempting it has no effect).

Step Action: End one or more other sessions from the panel.
Step Expected: The other sessions are ended.

Step Action: Reload `/account` on the current browser.
Step Expected: The customer remains signed in and the page loads normally.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The current browser's session was not affected by any action taken in the sessions panel.

Title: Verify that "Sign out everywhere else" clears every other session and leaves the current one working
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has live sessions on three or more devices/browsers, including the current one.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Session; Web; Smoke

Step Action: On the current browser, select "Sign out everywhere else."
Step Expected: The action is accepted.

Step Action: Observe the sessions panel.
Step Expected: Only the current session remains listed.

Step Action: On each of the other previously signed-in devices/browsers, attempt to use the application.
Step Expected: Each is signed out and required to sign in again.

Step Action: On the current browser, reload `/account`.
Step Expected: The customer remains signed in and the page loads normally.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: Exactly one live session remains — the current one — and all others have been invalidated.

Title: Verify that a silent sign-on attempt from another application does not succeed using a session ended via "Sign out everywhere else"
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- A customer had a live session on a second browser that was ended via "Sign out everywhere else" from the current browser.
- A registered application is configured to attempt silent authorization against that now-ended session.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Session; OAuth; Web; Edge Case

Step Action: From the browser whose session was ended, trigger a silent sign-on (silent authorization) attempt for the application.
Step Expected: The attempt does not resolve as an existing valid session; the customer is shown the ordinary sign-in screen rather than being silently authorized.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The ended session was not usable to complete a silent sign-on.

Title: Verify that ending a session does not affect a different device's session marked as belonging to an Entra-originated sign-in
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has a live GK One session originating from a native sign-in on one device and a live session originating from an Entra ID sign-in on another device.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Session; Entra ID; Edge Case

Step Action: End the native-origin session from the sessions panel.
Step Expected: [UNCERTAIN] Whether Entra-originated sessions are held in the same shared session store and subject to the same end/timeout behaviour as native sessions is not confirmed (see `squads/platform/features/entraid-mobile-integration/integration-points.md`). Confirm the Entra session is unaffected and still listed as live.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: [VERIFY: whether Entra-originated sessions share the same session store/lifecycle as native sessions / ask platform squad dev]

Title: Verify that revoking the same application twice in quick succession (double-click / race) does not error
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- The customer has an active consent grant for at least one application.
Tags: GK ID; Account Management; Web; Edge Case

Step Action: Trigger the revoke confirmation for an application, then submit the confirmation twice in rapid succession (e.g. double-click, or trigger the request from two open tabs at the same time).
Step Expected: The application is revoked exactly once; the second confirmation either no-ops gracefully or returns a clear "already revoked" outcome rather than an unhandled error.

Step Action: Reload the linked applications panel.
Step Expected: The application appears exactly once in the revoked state — i.e. it does not appear at all, and no duplicate or corrupted entry is present.

Step Action: Confirm the post conditions hold
Step Expected: The application's consent grant is revoked cleanly with no duplicate revoke side effects or error state left behind.
